note: HOMING KNOB — config:{homing:"empty_first"} INCREMENTAL (the live case). A PRIOR tree already binds w1 on D1's mount; a NEW window w2 arrives whose observed frame geometrically lands on D1 (it would pile under "focus"). With empty_first, ONLY the newcomer w2 is re-homed onto the empty D2 — the EXISTING w1 keeps its geometric home (a settled layout never reshuffles; _rehome_to_empty reassigns only the not-yet-bound newcomers, and D1 counts as OCCUPIED because w1 is already bound there). Final: root -> [d:1 -> w:1, d:2 -> w:2]. This is the property that makes empty_first safe to leave on live: adding windows fills empty screens without churning what is already placed.
